review.summary: Actual final/source contact sheet and full hero show preserved open cavity, continuous rim, rounded walls and brushed metal surface. No new visible reduction crack or major dent. Fresh FBX/GLB validation passes at 14,906 triangles with finite coordinates, UVs and no degenerate faces or loose vertices.

issues.problem: Minor rim waviness and corner softening remain close to the source; FBX inspection reports seven nonmanifold edges while GLB reports zero, with no visible major surface break in these views.

review.summary: Actual multiview sheet and full hero retain a brushed stainless tray with a continuous bright rim, metallic inner walls and floor, and an open cavity. No major paint contamination or missing surface; modest warmer reflections are consistent with the studio/reference.

issues.problem: Small rim highlight waviness and dark exterior reflections; recheck reduction for newly introduced dents or cracks.

review.summary: Actual five-view sheet and full hero show a single open rectangular tray with a continuous raised rim, rounded corners, sloped interior walls and intact flat floor. Reference proportions and hollow interior are retained; no major missing or merged component.

issues.problem: Mild vertical faceting and slightly softer corner radii than the reference; check their metallic shaded appearance and reduced output.
